content:
For most Gurugram businesses, the website is the second thing a prospect checks after hearing your name. A buyer in a Cyber City office, a family checking a clinic on Sohna Road, a channel partner looking at a Dwarka Expressway project: most open your site on a phone, often on patchy mobile data, and decide quickly whether to call. We are a design and development team based in Sector 49, working with local businesses for 7+ years. This page explains how we plan, build and hand over a website, what we need from you, and where we are honestly not the right choice.

What a finished website from us includes

Every project is scoped separately, but a typical business website leaves our hands with these things in place:

  • Designs you have approved for both mobile and desktop before any code is written, so nothing surprises you at launch.
  • A responsive front end in clean HTML, CSS and JavaScript, or a WordPress theme built around your content rather than a heavy multipurpose theme.
  • Enquiry paths that match how people here contact a business: tap-to-call, a WhatsApp chat button, and a short form that emails your team and keeps a copy of every lead.
  • On-page SEO groundwork: unique page titles and descriptions, a clean heading structure, an XML sitemap, business schema markup and a link to your Google Business Profile.
  • SSL, spam protection on forms and a backup routine set up on your hosting.
  • Google Analytics and Search Console connected and verified under your company's own Google account.

Custom code or WordPress?

This is the first decision we help you make. The right answer depends on how often the site will change and who will change it.

Custom-coded site

Suits a company profile, a product landing page or a site with one specific tool, such as a quote request form with part-number lookup for an auto-parts supplier in the Manesar belt. It loads fast and has very little to patch, but text changes usually need a developer.

WordPress

Suits teams that will publish updates themselves: blog posts, new project pages for a real estate developer, or doctor profiles for a hospital. It needs regular updates and a short, sensible plugin list to stay fast and secure.

How a project runs, week by week

A business website of 8 to 15 pages usually takes 4 to 7 weeks from sign-off to launch. Most delays come from content, not code.

  1. Week 1, discovery. We meet at our Sohna Road office, at yours or on a video call, list your services and audiences, look at competitor sites and agree a sitemap.
  2. Week 2, wireframes and design. You see the home page and one inner page in mobile and desktop layouts, and we revise until you approve.
  3. Weeks 3 to 5, development. We build on a private staging link you can open at any time, adding your content as it arrives.
  4. Week 6, testing. Speed, forms, browsers, devices and SEO checks, described below.
  5. Launch. We move the site to your live domain, set up 301 redirects from any old URLs so you keep the search traffic they earned, and watch Search Console for errors in the following weeks.

What we need from you

How quickly you can provide these is the biggest factor in whether we hit the timeline:

  • Your logo in vector or high-resolution format, and brand colours if you have them.
  • Text for each service, or an hour with someone senior so we can draft it for you.
  • Real photos of your team, office, products or finished work.
  • Logins for your domain registrar and hosting, or approval for us to set up hosting in your company's name.
  • One person on your side who can approve designs and copy within a few working days.

How we test before launch

A site does not go live until it passes these checks on a real mid-range Android phone as well as on desktop:

  • Core Web Vitals. We measure LCP, INP and CLS in PageSpeed Insights and fix what slows the page down, usually oversized images, render-blocking scripts or too many web fonts.
  • Slow network test. We throttle the connection to see how the site behaves on weak mobile data, not just office Wi-Fi.
  • Enquiry tests. Every form, call link and WhatsApp button is tested so we know each lead actually reaches you.
  • Security basics. HTTPS on every page, security headers, no leftover test files or exposed admin paths, and strong unique passwords.
  • Backup and restore. We take a full backup and confirm it can actually be restored.

Mistakes we often fix on local business websites

  • The phone number shown as an image, so mobile visitors cannot tap to call.
  • A large homepage slider that pushes the real offer below the fold and slows every visit.
  • The domain registered in a former employee's or freelancer's personal account, so the business cannot renew or move it.
  • Generic copy that could belong to any company, with no mention of the services, areas or industries you actually serve.

Who this service is not for

We are not a good fit if you need a site live in three days, want hundreds of near-identical pages made for search engines rather than people, or expect a website alone to bring leads without any work on content or marketing. If you only need a basic one-page presence, a site builder such as Wix may serve you better than an agency.

What decides the cost

We do not publish a price list, because two "10-page websites" can differ a lot in effort. The main cost drivers are the number of unique page layouts, whether we write the content, custom features such as booking, calculators or a client login, integration with a CRM or ERP, and extra languages such as Hindi. After a free consultation you get a fixed quote with the scope written out, not an open-ended hourly bill.

Ownership after handover

The domain, hosting, website files and Google accounts stay in your company's name. At handover you receive every login, the source files, and a short walkthrough on editing content. Any support period after launch is written into the quote so both sides know what is covered.

Questions Gurugram business owners ask us

Do I have to visit your office?

No. Many clients meet us once at Spaze I-Tech Park and handle the rest on calls and WhatsApp. For offices in Cyber City, Udyog Vihar or on Golf Course Road, we can come to you.

Can you redesign my current site without losing Google rankings?

Yes, with planning. We crawl the old site, map every URL to its new page, add 301 redirects and keep the content that already ranks. Rankings can shift for a few weeks after any redesign, so we watch Search Console closely.

Will you write the content for us?

We can. We interview you or your team and draft pages in plain English for your approval. Good content still needs your knowledge of customers and process, so expect to spend a few hours with us on it.

Who owns the website once it is live?

You do. Everything is registered to your company, and you can move the site to another developer or host at any time without asking us.

Do we have to take hosting and maintenance from you?

No. We can set up hosting in your name and offer a maintenance plan, but your in-house team can manage the site instead if you prefer.

Whether you still say Gurgaon or have switched to Gurugram, our office is easy to reach: Tower B1, Spaze I-Tech Park, Sohna Road, Sector 49. Book a free consultation or call +91 9050126213, and we will review your current site and goals and give you a realistic timeline before any quote.
